title: Famous Tres Palmas Casita: Gorgeous Ocean View
description: This modern casita is full of island charm and located in the most coveted location in Puerto Rico. The famous "Casita at Tres Palmas" offers indoor/outdoor living with a large covered deck that flows seamlessly from the open kitchen and living room. Wake up to check the waves then walk to surf at Rincon's most famous break: Tres Palmas. Snorkel at the Marine Reserve, located nearly at your door. Rinse off the salt in the outdoor shower or BBQ on the deck while listening to the waves.The spaceThis iconic Rincon property offers unmatched views and one of the most desired locations in Puerto Rico. An open design living and dining space leads right to an expansive deck with outdoor dining space and BBQ grill.
